channel.description: Latest articles from Aminiya (Daily Trust Hausa) (aminiya.ng)

item.title: Kwankwaso na tattaunawa da jam’iyyun ADC da NDC - Aminiya
item.description: Ƙungiyar Kwankwasiyya ta tabbatar da cewa jagoran NNPP kuma ɗan takarar shugaban ƙasa a Zaɓen 2023, Rabiu Musa Kwankwaso, na ci gaba da tattaunawa da jam’iyyun ADC da kuma NDC gabanin zaɓen 2027.

item.title: HOTUNA: Yadda aka tsaurara matakan tsaro yayin gurfanar da El-Rufai a Kotu - Aminiya
item.description: A wannan Talatar ce Hukumar Yaƙi da Cin Hanci da Rashawa ICPC ta gurfanar da tsohon gwamnan Jihar Kaduna, Nasir El-Rufai, a gaban Babbar Kotun Tarayya da ke Kaduna bisa zargin aikata laifukan da suka shafi karkatar da kuɗaɗe da kadarorin gwamnati ba bisa ƙa’ida ba.

item.title: EFCC ta ƙwace gidajen Malami a Abuja - Aminiya
item.description: Jami’an Hukumar EFCC mai yaƙi da masu yi wa tattalin arziki zagon ƙasa sun yi wa gidajen tsohon Ministan Shari’a, Abubakar Malami ƙawanya a wani yunkuri na ƙwace muhallin tsohon Babban Lauyan na Najeriya.

item.title: Kotu ta ƙi ba da belin El-Rufai - Aminiya
item.description: Babbar Kotun Tarayya da ke zamanta a Kaduna ta yi watsi da buƙatar bayar da belin tsohon gwamnan jihar, Nasir El-Rufai, bayan da aka gurfanar da shi a gabanta a ranar Talata.

item.title: Muna fama da ƙarancin jami’ai mata a Kano — NDLEA - Aminiya
item.description: Hukumar Yaƙi da Sha da Fataucin Miyagun Kwayoyi ta Kasa (NDLEA), tana fama da ƙarancin jami’ai mata a Jihar Kano, lamarin da ta bayyana a matsayin babban ƙalubale da ke kawo cikas a ayyukanta.

item.title: Yadda ’yan sanda suka koma neman fetur a hannun masu ababen hawa a Gombe - Aminiya
item.description: Wani al'amari da ya faru ya janyo wa rundunar ’yan sandan Jihar Gombe surutu, bayan da aka zargi wasu jami’anta da tursasa wa masu ababen hawa bayar da man fetur a matsayin fansar saɓa dokokin hanya.

item.title: Yadda jigon APC daga Kano ya rasu a Otel a Abuja - Aminiya
item.description: Wani babban jigo a Jam’iyyar APC daga Jihar Kano, Barista Abdulsalami Ginsau, ya riga mu gidan gaskiya a otel Chida da ke Birnin Tarayya, Abuja.

item.title: Sojoji sun daƙile harin ’yan ya’adda a Yobe - Aminiya
item.description: Dakarun haɗin gwiwa na Operation Haɗin Kai sun yi nasarar daƙile wani hari da ake zargin mayaƙan Boko Haram da na ISWAP suka kai a Jihar Yobe.

item.title: An kashe mutum 2, wasu sun jikkata a sabon hari a Filato - Aminiya
item.description: ’Yan bindiga sun sake kai wani sabon hari a unguwar Ban da ke maƙwabtaka da Kwalejin Fasaha ta Jihar Filato, inda suka hallaka mutum biyu tare da jikkata wasu da dama.

item.title: Sojoji sun ceto mutane uku da aka sace a Borno
item.description: Sojojin Operation Haɗin Kai sun ceto fararen hula uku da aka sace tare da ƙwato harsasai a lokacin wani samame akan ’yan ta'adda a ƙaramar hukumar Bama da ke jihar Borno.

item.title: Easter: NSCDC ta tura jami’ai don tabbatar da tsaro a Gombe
item.description: Rundunar Tsaron farin kaya ta Sibil Difense NSCDC a Jihar Gombe, ta tura jami’ai 726 zuwa muhimman wurare a faɗin jihar domin tabbatar da zaman lafiya da tsaro yayin bukukuwan Easter.

item.title: Rikicin Filato: Jami'an tsaro sun ƙarfafa tsaro a Jos
item.description: An samu komawar yanayin zaman lafiya a Jos, babban birnin jihar Filato, biyo bayan sassaucin doka da aka samu a yankin ranar Laraba.

item.title: Duk da Gwamnonin APC 30 Tinubu na fargaba — David Mark
item.description: Shugaban Jam’iyyar ADC na ƙasa, David Mark ya buƙaci Shugaba Bola Tinubu da ya bayyana dalilin da ya sa yake nuna fargaba duk da cewa yana da gwamnoni sama da 30 a ƙarƙashin jam’iyya mai mulki ta APC.

item.title: Tinubu ya umarci yin amfani da kyamarorin tsaro a Jos
item.description: Shugaban Najeriya, Bola Tinubu ya bayar da umarnin girka sama da kyamarori 5,000 na fasahar AI a Jihar Filato domin inganta tsaro bayan hare-haren da suka yi sanadin mutuwar mutane a Jos.

item.title: An dawo da dokar takaita hawa babur a Gombe
item.description: Dokar, wadda ta haramta amfani da babura daga karfe 7:00 na yamma zuwa 6:00 na safe kowace rana, za ta fara aiki daga ranar Juma’a, 3 ga Afrilu, 2026.
